args.note: The request requires blocking all elastic waves below 16.8 kHz, including frequencies arbitrarily close to zero. Clarification returned: Everything I need is in the request.

The literal requirement is a complete elastic-wave gap from zero to 16.8 kHz. Passive, ungrounded periodic lattice cores have acoustic branches whose frequencies approach zero at long wavelengths, so they cannot exclude all elastic waves throughout this interval. This applies regardless of PA12 cell geometry or the 20 mm period. No design released.
